verdict.rationale: The GST portal is a software product where users view their own data, such as dashboards, returns and ITC forms, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair axis to judge. However, the evidence pack documents only registration, return filing, ITC, payments, notices and help modules. Nothing in it mentions AI-generated insights, analytics or suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
